title.en: Bowing to the Goddess and asking pardon

items.action: Face the starting direction with your palms joined in añjali.
items.meaning: Salutations to Sandhyā, the goddess of the junctures of the day.

items.action: Turn a quarter turn clockwise.
items.meaning: Salutations to Sāvitrī.

items.action: Turn a quarter turn clockwise.
items.meaning: Salutations to Gāyatrī.

items.action: Turn a quarter turn clockwise.
items.meaning: Salutations to Sarasvatī.

items.action: Turn back to the starting direction.
items.meaning: Salutations again and again to all the deities.

items.action: Say this with your palms joined.
items.meaning: I did not sin of my own accord; falling under the sway of desire and anger I sinned unwittingly. Forgive me — I salute you again and again.

todo: Bow to the goddess of the junctures of the day in her forms and to all deities, and ask pardon for what desire and anger made you do.
Stand with your palms joined in añjali.
Turn clockwise, saluting the four directions in turn.

todo.text: Begin facing east, then face south, west and north.
Begin facing west, then face north, east and south.

todo: Return to the starting direction for the last two mantras.

title.en: Presenting yourself by lineage and name

text.iast: abhivādaye {pravara} {arsheya} pravarānvita {gotra} gotraḥ {sutra} sūtraḥ yajuśśākhādhyāyī śrī {name} śarmā nāmāham asmi bhoḥ ||

items.action: Say this bent forward with your hands over your ears. Then touch the ground.
items.meaning: I salute — I, of the pravara of the ṛṣis {pravara}, of the {gotra} gotra, of the {sutra} sūtra, a student of the Yajur śākhā, named {name} śarmā.

items.text: After the pravara ṛṣis, say *trayārṣeya* if your pravara has three ṛṣis and *pañcārṣeya* if it has five.

todo: Bend forward at the waist.
Cover your ears with your hands. Some cross the forearms, right over left, to do this.
Say your lineage and name: your pravara (the sages of your lineage), gotra, sūtra and name.
These are filled in from Settings; blanks appear as “…” until you fill them in.
Then touch the ground (or the feet of elders who are present) and stand upright.

title.en: Saluting every direction, above and below

items.action: Face east.
items.meaning: Salutations to the eastern quarter.

items.action: Face south.
items.meaning: Salutations to the southern quarter.

items.action: Face west.
items.meaning: Salutations to the western quarter.

items.action: Face north.
items.meaning: Salutations to the northern quarter.

items.action: Face west.
items.meaning: Salutations to the western quarter.

items.action: Face north.
items.meaning: Salutations to the northern quarter.

items.action: Face east.
items.meaning: Salutations to the eastern quarter.

items.action: Face south.
items.meaning: Salutations to the southern quarter.

items.action: Face the starting direction, point your joined palms up and look above.
items.meaning: Salutations to what is above.

items.action: Point your joined palms down and look below.
items.meaning: Salutations to what is below.

items.action: Point your palms up and look towards the sky.
items.meaning: Salutations to the atmosphere.

items.action: Point your palms down and look towards the earth.
items.meaning: Salutations to the Earth.

items.action: Point your palms up.
items.meaning: Salutations to Brahmā.

items.action: Point your palms down or straight ahead, and think of the Lord in the disc of the Sun.
items.meaning: Salutations to Viṣṇu.

items.action: Point your palms up.
items.meaning: Salutations to Rudra.

items.action: Point your palms down.
items.meaning: Salutations to Yama.

todo: Stand with your palms joined in añjali and turn clockwise again, as you did for the salutations to Sandhyā.

todo.text: Start from the east and end with the north.
Start from the west and end with the south.

todo: Then, facing the starting direction, point your joined palms up and down in turn for the remaining salutations.

title.en: Bowing to Yama, lord of dharma and time

text.iast:
yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca |
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca ||
audumbarāya dadhnāya nīlāya parameṣṭhine |
vṛkodarāya citrāya citraguptāya vai namaḥ ||
citraguptāya vai nama oṃ nama iti ||

items.action: Face south and say this with your palms joined.
items.meaning: Salutations to Yama, King Dharma, Death, the Ender, the son of Vivasvān (the Sun), Time, the destroyer of all beings; to Audumbara, Dadhna, the blue-hued one, the supreme lord, the insatiable one, the wondrous one, and to Citragupta who records all deeds — salutations.

todo: Face south and join your palms in añjali.
Bow to Yama, lord of dharma and of time, and to Citragupta, who keeps the record of deeds.

title.en: Saluting the one Supreme, Hari and Hara together

text.iast:
ṛ̱taguṃ sa̱tyaṃ pa̍raṃ bra̱hma̱ pu̱ruṣa̍ṃ kṛṣṇa̱ piṅga̍lam |
ū̱rdhvare̍taṃ vi̍rūpā̱kṣa̱ṃ vi̱śvarū̍pāya̱ vai namo̱ nama̍ḥ ||
viśvarūpāya vai nama oṃ nama iti ||

items.action: Say this with your palms joined.
items.meaning: The Cosmic Order, the Truth, the Supreme Brahman — the Person dark-blue and tawny, of restrained seed, three-eyed: salutations again and again to Him of universal form.

todo: Join your palms in añjali and recite.

text.iast:
narmadāyai namaḥ prātar narmadāyai namo niśi |
namo 'stu narmade tubhyaṃ trāhi māṃ viṣasarpataḥ ||
apasarpa sarpa bhadraṃ te dūraṃ gaccha mahāyaśaḥ |
janamejayasya yajñānte āstīka vacanaṃ smaran ||
jaratkārvor jaratkārvāṃ samutpanno mahāyaśaḥ |
āstīkassatyasandho māṃ pannagebhyo 'bhirakṣatu ||
pannagebhyo 'bhirakṣatu oṃ nama iti ||

items.action: Say this with your palms joined.
items.meaning: Salutations to Narmadā by day, salutation to Narmadā by night; salutations to you, Narmadā — protect me from venomous serpents. Go away, serpent — blessings on you — go far, O renowned one, remembering Āstīka's word at the end of Janamejaya's sacrifice. May Āstīka of great renown, true to his vow, born of Jaratkāru and Jaratkāru, protect me from serpents.

todo: Pray to the river Narmadā and the sage Āstīka for protection from snakes.
Join your palms in añjali and recite.

title.en: Surrendering to Nārāyaṇa in the Sun

text.iast:
namaḥ savitre jagadeka cakṣuṣe jagat prasūti sthiti nāśa hetave |
trayīmayāya triguṇātma dhāriṇe viriñci nārāyaṇa śaṅkarātmane ||

items.meaning: Salutations to Savitā, the sole eye of the world, the cause of the creation, sustenance and dissolution of the universe, who is the three Vedas, who bears the three guṇas, and who is of the nature of Brahmā, Nārāyaṇa and Śaṅkara.
items.action: Say this with your palms joined.

text.iast:
dhyeyassadā savitṛ maṇḍala madhyavartī nārāyaṇaḥ sarasijāsana sanniviṣṭaḥ |
keyūravān makara kuṇḍalavān kirīṭī hārī hiraṇmaya vapuḥ dhṛta śaṅkha cakraḥ ||

items.meaning: Nārāyaṇa, seated in the centre of the disc of the Sun on a lotus seat, is ever to be meditated upon — adorned with armlets, makara earrings, crown and necklace, of golden body, holding the conch and discus.
items.action: Say this with your palms joined.

text.iast:
śaṅkha cakra gadā pāṇe dvārakā nilayācyuta |
govinda puṇḍarīkākṣa rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam ||

items.meaning: O wielder of conch, discus and mace, dweller in Dvārakā, Acyuta, Govinda, lotus-eyed one — protect me who have taken refuge in You.
items.action: Say this with your palms joined.

text.iast:
ākāśāt patitaṃ toyaṃ yathā gacchati sāgaram |
sarvadeva namaskāraḥ keśavaṃ prati gacchati ||
keśavaṃ prati gacchaty oṃ nama iti ||

items.meaning: Just as water fallen from the sky reaches the ocean, so salutation to any god reaches Keśava alone.
items.action: Say this with your palms joined.

text.iast:
namo brahmaṇya devāya go brāhmaṇa hitāya ca |
jagaddhitāya kṛṣṇāya govindāya namo namaḥ ||

items.meaning: Salutations again and again to the God of the brāhmaṇas, the well-wisher of cows and brāhmaṇas, the well-wisher of the world — to Kṛṣṇa, to Govinda.
items.action: Say this with your palms joined.

items.text: After this step, do four *sāṣṭāṅga namaskārams* (full prostrations).

todo: Join your palms in añjali.
Think of Nārāyaṇa in the disc of the Sun as you recite.
Every salutation, to any deity, finally reaches Him.

text.iast: abhivādaye {pravara} {arsheya} pravarānvita {gotra} gotraḥ {sutra} sūtraḥ yajuśśākhādhyāyī śrī {name} śarmā nāmāham asmi bhoḥ ||

items.action: Say this bent forward with your hands over your ears. Then touch the ground.
items.meaning: I salute — I, of the pravara of the ṛṣis {pravara}, of the {gotra} gotra, of the {sutra} sūtra, a student of the Yajur śākhā, named {name} śarmā.

todo: Repeat the abhivādanam from the earlier Abhivādanam step: bend forward, cover your ears with your hands, say your lineage and name, and touch the ground.

title.en: Offering everything you did to Nārāyaṇa

text.iast: bhagavāneva svaniyāmya svarūpasthiti pravṛtti svaśeṣataika rasena anena ātmanā kartrā svakīyaiśca upakaraṇaiḥ svārādhanaika prayojanāya paramapuruṣaḥ sarvaśeṣī śriyaḥ patiḥ svaśeṣabhūtaṃ idaṃ {kala} sandhyāvandanākhyaṃ karma svasmai svaprītaye svayameva kāritavān ||

items.action: Say this with your palms joined in añjali.
items.meaning: The Lord Himself, the Supreme Person, master of all and consort of Śrī, has had this {kalaEn} sandhyāvandanam done through me. I am His servant, my nature and actions are ruled by Him, and the tools I used are His. It was done for His own worship and His own pleasure.

text.iast:
śrīraṅga maṅgalamaṇiṃ karuṇā nivāsam śrī veṅkaṭādri śikharālaya kālamegham |
śrī hastiśaila śikharojvala pārijātam śrīśaṃ namāmi śirasā yaduśailadīpam ||

items.meaning: I bow my head to the Lord of Śrī: the auspicious jewel of Śrīraṅgam, abode of compassion; the dark rain-cloud on the peak of Veṅkaṭādri; the pārijāta shining on the summit of Hastiśaila (Kāñcī); the lamp of Yadu hill (Melkoṭe).

text.iast:
kāyena vācā manasendriyair vā buddhyātmanā vā prakṛteḥ svabhāvāt |
karomi yad yat sakalaṃ parasmai nārāyaṇāyeti samarpayāmi ||

items.action: Recite this, then let the water fall from your right palm to the ground.
items.meaning: Whatever I do with body, speech, mind or senses, with the intellect or the self, or by the very nature of my disposition — all that I offer to the Supreme Nārāyaṇa.

text.iast:
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktihīnaṃ janārdana |
yat kṛtaṃ tu mayā deva paripūrṇaṃ tad astu te ||

items.meaning: Deficient as it is in mantra, in method and in devotion, O Janārdana — whatever has been done by me, O God, may it be complete for You.

text.iast:
prāyaścittāny aśeṣāṇi tapaḥ karmātmakāni vai |
yāni teṣām aśeṣāṇāṃ kṛṣṇānusmaraṇaṃ param ||
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa |

items.meaning: Of all the expiations consisting of austerity and ritual action, the highest of them all is the remembrance of Kṛṣṇa.

todo: Offer everything done by body, speech, mind and nature to Nārāyaṇa.
Sit down.

todo.text: First say the sātvika tyāgam with your palms joined in añjali.

todo: Take a little water in your right palm, recite the verse below, and let the water fall to the ground.

title.en: Purifying once more before the close

todo: Stay seated and do the ācamanam again.
Take a sip and swallow it with each of the three names, then touch your body with the twelve names.

items.action: Pour a little water into your right palm and swallow it.
items.meaning: Salutations to Acyuta, the unfallen, unchanging one.

items.action: Pour water into your palm again and swallow it.
items.meaning: Salutations to Ananta, the infinite one.

items.action: Pour water once more and swallow it. Then wash your right hand.
items.meaning: Salutations to Govinda, protector of the cows and of the earth.

text.iast: oṃ keśavāya namaḥ | oṃ nārāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ mādhavāya namaḥ | oṃ govindāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ | oṃ madhusūdanāya namaḥ | oṃ trivikramāya namaḥ | oṃ vāmanāya namaḥ | oṃ śrīdharāya namaḥ | oṃ hṛṣīkeśāya namaḥ | oṃ padmanābhāya namaḥ | oṃ dāmodarāya namaḥ ||

items.action: Touch the same twelve places as in the Aṅga-nyāsam step, one for each name.
items.meaning: Salutations to Keśava, Nārāyaṇa, Mādhava, Govinda, Viṣṇu, Madhusūdana, Trivikrama, Vāmana, Śrīdhara, Hṛṣīkeśa, Padmanābha and Dāmodara.

title.en: Sealing the rite and offering it to Brahman

text.iast:
a̱dyā no̍ deva savitaḥ pra̱jāva̍t sāvī̱ḥ saubha̍gam | parā̍ du̱ḥṣvapniyagu̍ṃ suva ||
oṃ viśvā̎ni deva savitar duri̱tāni parā̍ suva | yad bha̱draṃ tanna̱ āsu̍va ||

items.action: Sprinkle water on the place where you sat, then touch it and apply it to your forehead.
items.meaning: Send us this day, O God Savitā, prosperity with progeny; drive away from us the evil dream. O God Savitā, drive away from us all sins and misfortunes; send us what is good.

items.action: Sprinkle water on the place where you did the sandhyāvandanam.
items.meaning: Om, earth, atmosphere, heaven.
Salutations to Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

items.action: Pour a little water.
items.meaning: Om, That is Truth — may this be an offering to Brahman.

items.text: Finally, do a *sāṣṭāṅga namaskāram* (full prostration) four times. This completes the {kalaEn} sandhyāvandanam.

todo: Bless the place, ask for protection and freedom from bad dreams, and hand the whole act over to Brahman.
Take a little water in your hand and sprinkle it on the spot where you sat for the sandhyāvandanam.
Touch the sprinkled water with your right ring finger and apply it to your forehead as a tilakam.

todo.text: After sprinkling, say *śrī kṛṣṇāya namaḥ* ten times.

todo: Finish with the brahmārpaṇam (offering to Brahman): pour a little water as you say it.
